name: LiquidEther-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Brightest tangle of purple liquid folds, filling the centre with visible swirls.

tagline: Purple liquid curls and swirls across a black field.
summary: A fluid simulation stirs smoky purple liquid over black, folding colour into dark hollows and letting it fade again. Moving the pointer pushes a glowing splash of colour through the liquid.
appearance: Smoky purple liquid swirls across a near-black field, lit violet and lilac with soft blurred edges. Shapes fold into one another like ink stirred in dark water, brightest where the liquid bends.
behaviour: The liquid churns without pause, curling into new folds and fading back toward black. Moving the pointer pushes a bright bloom of colour into the fluid, which then spreads out and dims.
demo_content: Purple liquid on black, stirred by the automatic demo pointer.
search_phrases: ink in water effect on dark
gooey purple splash that follows the mouse
organic fluid distortion for a hero
use_when: A creative or AI page wants a living, fluid surface that answers the pointer.
avoid_when: A heavy simulation with a dark palette that makes overlaid small text hard to read.
customise: Pointer force, cursor size, viscosity, solver iterations, resolution, palette and auto-demo motion are props; the shader passes need source edits.
weight_why: A multi-pass fluid simulation renders every frame in WebGL.

a11y.note: A canvas backdrop with nothing to label; the constant churn ignores reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Fluid motion looks convincing and rich; edges blur into black and the palette stays one hue.
title: Liquid Ether
